create_HgTokenizerConfig: create an HgTokenizerConfig with custom special tokens like unk, bos, eos, pad, boh, and eoh
create_HgTokenizer: create an HgTokenizer instance by passing an HG token model to the constructor
encode_decode_HgTokenizer: encode text to token tensors and decode token tensors back to text using HgTokenizer
create_encoder_decoder_HgTokenizer: create a HuggingFaceTokenEncoder or HuggingFaceTokenDecoder from an HgTokenizer with optional device and pin_memory settings
load_hg_tokenizer: load an HgTokenizer from a file path using load_hg_tokenizer with an HgTokenizerConfig for special tokens
